text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I am King. As a first-rate Umamusume, I'll 
show the entire world exactly why a King 
is King.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
For that sake, I grant you the privilege 
of supporting me! Follow this King as a 
first-rate Trainer!

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
